content.value: The R.J. Smith Corporation is a publisher of romance novels- just stories of common people. The corporation hires an economist to determine the demand for its novel. After months of hard work the economist informed the corporation that the demand for the firm's novel $( Q _ { x } )$ is given by the following equation-$\mathrm { Q } _ { x } = 1 2 , 0 0 0 - 5 , 0 0 0 \mathrm { P } _ { x } + 5 1 + 5 0 0 \mathrm { P } _ { 0 }$
Assume that the initial values of $\mathsf { P } _ { \mathsf { X } } , \mathsf { I }$ and $\mathsf { P } _ { \mathsf { c } }$ are \$5, \$10,000 and \$6 respectively.
Using the above information, the company's manager wants to-
(ii) Determine what effect a price increase would have on total revenues.
(iii) Evaluate how sale of the novels would change during a period of rising incomes.
(iv) Assess the probable impact if competing publishers would raise their prices.
